[P5] 消息在蚂蚁王国的坑道里传得很快。一只侦察蚁带着了不起的新发现回来——一颗美丽耀眼的水晶。侦察蚁把水晶献给蚁后，蚁后尝了一口，立刻把整颗水晶吃了个精光。

[P6] 蚁后宣布这是她吃过的最可口的食物，如果能吃到更多，她将获得无上的快乐。蚂蚁们明白她的意思，他们迫切地想要收集更多的水晶献给她。蚁后是所有蚂蚁的母亲，只要她快乐，整个蚁窝就是快乐的王国。

[P7] 他们出发的时候，天色已经不早了，长长的阴影遮住蚂蚁王国的入口。蚂蚁一只接着一只爬出洞穴，跟在侦察蚁后面。侦察蚁出发前说得很清楚，在他找到水晶的地方，还有很多很多水晶，不过路途既遥远又危险。

[P8] 他们走进森林，这片森林围绕在蚂蚁王国的四周。天色由黄昏逐渐转暗，接着就天黑了。他们行走的小路弯弯曲曲，每转一个弯，就更深入阴暗的森林。

[P9] 他们不时停下脚步，不安地聆听，听一听有没有饥饿的蜘蛛发出声音。不过，他们听到的只是蟋蟀的叫声，在森林里回荡，像是远方传来的雷鸣。

[P10] 蚂蚁上方的叶片有露珠凝聚，冰凉的大水珠出奇不意地滴在蚂蚁身上。一只萤火虫从上空飞过，刺眼的青光霎时闪过森林。

[P11] 森林边缘耸立着一座山。蚂蚁抬头看，看不见顶端，山高得仿佛直达天堂。他们没有停下脚步，沿着山壁一直往上爬，越爬越高，越爬越高。

[P12] 风从山壁的缝隙呼啸而过，蚂蚁感觉强风吹弯了他们纤细的触须，他们的腿因为奋力往上爬，也越来越没有力气。最后，他们爬上一块凸出的岩石，然后穿过一条狭窄的通道。

[P13] 蚂蚁爬出通道，看到一个陌生的世界。他们熟悉的泥土、青草、腐烂的植物的气味，全都消失了。这里没有风，更奇怪的是，天空好像也不见了。

[P14] 他们横穿光滑的地面，再跟着侦察蚁爬上圆弧形、像玻璃一样的墙壁，终于抵达了目的地。从墙头往下看，只见一片水晶大海。蚂蚁一只接着一只爬下去，进入这座闪闪发光的宝库。

[P15] 蚂蚁动作迅速，各自选好了一颗水晶，然后开始往回走。
这里和蚂蚁熟悉的自然环境截然不同，他们觉得很不自在，
不愿久留。但是，他们走得太匆忙，根本没注意有两只小蚂蚁留在后面。

[P16] “为什么要回去？”一只小蚂蚁问另外一只，“这个地方虽然感觉不像家里，可是看看这些水晶。”“你说得对，”另一只蚂蚁说，“我们可以待在这里，每天享受美食，永远不要离开。”于是两只小蚂蚁吃个不停，吃到他们胀得不能动，倒头睡觉为止。

[P17] 天亮了。熟睡的两只小蚂蚁还不知道他们的新家有了变化。一把巨大的银铲子在他们头上晃动，然后伸进水晶深处，一下子就把他和水晶铲了起来，举得高高的。

[P18] 铲子一翻转，惊醒了两只小蚂蚁，他们从吓人的高空往下掉，跟着滑落的水晶在空中翻滚，最后掉进滚烫的褐色湖水里。

[P19] 巨大的铲子激烈地来回搅拌，翻天覆地的大浪冲向小蚂蚁。他们用力拍打，尽量把头伸出水面，可是铲子还是不停搅动着热腾腾的褐色液体。

[P20] 铲子转了一圈又一圈，水面形成的漩涡把蚂蚁卷了进去，越卷越深。小蚂蚁屏住呼吸，好不容易才浮出水面，他们赶紧大口吸气，把灌进嘴里的苦水吐出来。

[P21] 接着，湖面倾斜，湖水开始流入一个洞穴。小蚂蚁听到急流的水声，感觉自己正被拉往那个漆黑的洞穴。突然，洞穴消失了，湖面恢复平静。小蚂蚁往岸上游，却发现湖边都是峭壁。

[P22] 他们赶紧翻越峭壁。这两只受到惊吓的小蚂蚁，想找
个地方藏身，生怕巨大的铲子再把他们铲起来。他们在附近找
到一个又大又圆的东西，上面有许多洞孔，恰好适合躲藏。

[P23] 可是他们才刚刚爬进去，这个藏身处就被抬高、翻转，
然后被扔进一个黑漆漆的洞里。小蚂蚁爬出洞口一看，发现
他们被奇怪的红光包围，而且温度正在急速攀升。

[P24] 过了不久，温度就高得无法忍受，差一点儿把他们烤熟。
突然，两只热蚂蚁站立的东西像火箭一样冲上去，把他们抛向空中。

[P25] 他们坠落的地方，靠近一处泉水，那泉水像一道瀑布，
沿着一根银管子直流而下。两只小蚂蚁渴得不得了，他们好
想把发烫的头浸在清凉的水里，于是起身，飞快地沿着管子
往前爬。

[P26] 一靠近瀑布，两只小蚂蚁立刻感觉到凉爽的水汽。他们紧紧抓住管子光滑的表面，慢慢把头探进流动的泉水中。但是水流太急了。

[P27] 小小的蚂蚁被泉水冲开，掉进一个潮湿、黑暗的房间，
掉落在吃剩的水果和湿答答的厨房垃圾上面。突然，四周响起
吵闹、可怕的声音。房间开始旋转。

[P28] 两只小蚂蚁被卷入一场风暴当中，雨如针刺，食物残渣齐飞。不一会儿，噪声和旋转又突然停止。小蚂蚁爬出房间，伤痕累累、头晕目眩。

[P29] 他们回到日光下，快速地跑过几处水洼，爬上一面平滑的金属墙。远处有两个狭长的洞，让他们看了心安不少，因为那就像是他们在地下的家，温暖又安全。于是，他们爬进了黑暗的洞口。

[P30] 可是洞里并不安全。有一股强大的力量通过他们湿淋淋的身体，把他们震得全身发麻，然后像子弹一样弹射出去。当他们着地的时候，两只小蚂蚁已经没有力气继续往前。他们爬到一个阴暗的角落，沉沉地睡了。

[P31] 天黑了，受尽折磨的小蚂蚁被熟悉的声音吵醒了——原来是同伴的脚步声，他们又来搬运更多的水晶。两只小蚂蚁静静地跟在队伍后面，爬上像玻璃一样的墙面，再一次站在宝物当中，不过这一次，他们选好了水晶，就跟着同伴踏上归途。

[P32] 站在蚁窝的入口，两只小蚂蚁听到了地下传来的欢笑声。
他们知道蚁后收到水晶，一定会满心欢喜。这一刻，两只小蚂蚁感到前所未有的快乐，这是他们的家，里面住着他们的家人。他们属于这里。

[P5] News spread quickly through the tunnels of the ant kingdom. A scout ant returned with an amazing discovery—a beautiful, sparkling crystal. The scout presented the crystal to the queen, who took a bite and immediately ate the entire crystal clean.

[P6] The queen ant announced that this was the most delicious food she had ever eaten. If she could eat more, she would gain supreme happiness. The ants understood her meaning and eagerly wanted to collect more crystals to offer her. The queen ant is the mother of all ants. As long as she is happy, the entire anthill is a kingdom of happiness.

[P7] When they set out, it was already late, and long shadows covered the entrance to the ant kingdom. The ants crawled out of the cave one after another, following behind the scout ant. The scout ant had made it clear before departure: there were many, many more crystals where he found them, but the journey was both distant and dangerous.

[P8] They walked into the forest, which surrounded the ant kingdom. The sky gradually darkened from dusk, and then it became night. The path they walked on was winding; with each turn, they went deeper into the dark forest.

[P9] They would occasionally stop, listening anxiously to see if any hungry spiders were making sounds. But all they heard was the chirping of crickets echoing through the forest, like distant thunder.

[P10] Dewdrops gathered on the leaves above the ants, and a cold, large droplet unexpectedly fell onto them. A firefly flew overhead, and its blinding green light flashed through the forest for a moment.

[P11] At the edge of the forest stands a mountain. The ants look up and cannot see the top; the mountain is so high it seems to reach heaven. They do not stop, climbing steadily up the mountain wall, higher and higher, higher and higher.

[P12] The wind howled through the cracks in the cliff face. The ants felt the strong wind bending their delicate antennae, and their legs, strained from climbing upward, grew weaker and weaker. Finally, they climbed onto a protruding rock and then passed through a narrow passage.

[P13] The ants crawled out of the passage and saw a strange world. The familiar smells of soil, grass, and decaying plants had all disappeared. There was no wind here, and even more strangely, the sky seemed to be gone.

[P14] They crossed the smooth ground, then followed the scout ant up a curved, glass-like wall, finally reaching their destination. Looking down from the wall, they saw a sea of crystals. One by one, the ants climbed down, entering this glittering treasure trove.

[P15] The ants moved quickly, each selecting a crystal, and then began to head back.
This place was utterly different from the natural environment the ants were familiar with; they felt very uncomfortable and did not want to stay long. However, they were moving too hastily and completely failed to notice that two little ants had been left behind.

[P16] "Why do we have to go back?" one little ant asked the other. "This place doesn't feel like home, but look at all these crystals." "You're right," the other ant said. "We can stay here, enjoy delicious food every day, and never leave." So the two little ants kept eating, until they were so full they couldn't move, and then they fell asleep.

[P17] It was morning. The two little ants, still asleep, didn't know their new home had changed. A huge silver shovel moved above their heads, then reached deep into the crystals, scooping them up along with the crystals and lifting them high into the air.

[P18] The shovel flipped over, waking up two little ants. They fell from a terrifying height, tumbling through the air with the falling crystals, and finally landed in the scalding brown lake.

[P19] The huge shovel violently stirred back and forth, sending翻天覆地 waves crashing toward the little ants. They struggled, paddling hard and trying to keep their heads above the surface, but the shovel kept churning the hot, brown liquid.

[P20] The shovel turned round and round, and the whirlpool on the surface pulled the ants in, deeper and deeper. The little ants held their breath, and only with great difficulty did they float to the surface. They quickly took big breaths and spat out the bitter water that had filled their mouths.

[P21] Next, the lake surface tilted, and water began to flow into a cave. The little ants heard the rushing sound of water and felt themselves being pulled toward that dark cave. Suddenly, the cave disappeared, and the lake surface calmed down. The little ants swam toward the shore, only to find that the lake's edge was made of sheer cliffs.

[P22] They hurriedly climbed over the cliff. These two frightened little ants wanted to find
a place to hide, afraid that the huge shovel would scoop them up again. They found a large, round object nearby, with many holes on it, perfectly suitable for hiding.

[P23] But just as they had crawled in, this hiding place was lifted, flipped,
and then thrown into a dark, pitch-black hole. The little ants crawled out of the hole and saw that
they were surrounded by strange red light, and the temperature was rising rapidly.

[P24] Not long after, the temperature became unbearable, almost roasting them.
Suddenly, the thing the two hot ants were standing on shot up like a rocket, throwing them into the air.

[P25] The place where they fell was near a spring. The spring water flowed down like a waterfall, 
along a silver pipe. The two little ants were terribly thirsty. They longed 
to dip their hot heads into the cool water, so they stood up and quickly crawled 
forward along the pipe.

[P26] As they approached the waterfall, the two little ants immediately felt the cool mist. They gripped tightly onto the smooth surface of the pipe, slowly dipping their heads into the flowing spring water. But the current was too swift.

[P27] The tiny ants were washed away by the spring water, falling into a damp, dark room,
landing on leftover fruit and wet kitchen garbage. Suddenly, loud, terrifying sounds echoed from all around. The room began to spin.

[P28] Two little ants were swept into a storm, with rain like needles and food scraps flying everywhere. In a moment, the noise and spinning suddenly stopped. The ants crawled out of the room, battered and dizzy.

[P29] They returned to the sunlight, quickly running past a few puddles and climbing up a smooth metal wall. In the distance, there were two narrow holes that gave them a sense of comfort, as they looked like their underground home—warm and safe. So, they crawled into the dark opening.

[P30] But the hole was not safe. A powerful force passed through their wet bodies, shaking them until they were numb, then shooting them out like bullets. When they landed, the two little ants had no strength left to go on. They crawled into a dark corner and fell into a deep sleep.

[P31] It was dark. The little ants, worn out from their ordeal, were awakened by a familiar sound—the footsteps of their companions, who had come again to carry more crystals. The two little ants quietly followed behind the group, climbing up a wall as smooth as glass, and once again stood among the treasures. But this time, they had chosen their crystals, and then followed their companions on the journey home.

[P32] Standing at the entrance of the anthill, the two little ants heard laughter coming from underground.
They knew the queen would be overjoyed to receive the crystal. At this moment, the two little ants felt an unprecedented happiness. This was their home, where their family lived. They belonged here.

[P21] 两只小蚂蚁在滚烫的褐色湖水中挣扎，被漩涡卷入后浮出水面，发现湖面倾斜，湖水流入洞穴，随后洞穴消失，湖面恢复平静，它们游向岸边却发现四周是峭壁。
[P22] 两只被遗落的小蚂蚁在滚烫湖水后奋力游向岸边，发现四周是峭壁，便赶紧翻越峭壁，寻找藏身之处，最终发现一个又大又圆、布满洞孔的物体，适合躲藏。
[P23] 两只小蚂蚁刚躲进一个布满洞孔的物体中，该物体突然被抬高、翻转并扔进一个黑暗的洞里，它们爬出后发现被红光包围，温度急剧上升。
[P24] 两只小蚂蚁在被红光包围的高温环境中，所站立的物体突然像火箭一样冲起，将它们抛向空中。
[P25] 两只小蚂蚁在坠落后发现一处泉水，因口渴难耐，便沿着银管子向水流方向爬去。
[P26] 两只小蚂蚁靠近瀑布，感受到凉爽水汽，试图抓住管子探头喝水，但水流太急。
[P27] 两只小蚂蚁被泉水冲进一个潮湿黑暗的房间，落在厨余垃圾上，随后房间开始旋转并响起可怕的声音。
[P28] 两只小蚂蚁在风暴中被卷入，经历雨如针刺、食物残渣飞舞的混乱后，风暴突然停止，它们伤痕累累、头晕目眩地爬出房间。
[P29] 两只小蚂蚁回到日光下，穿过水洼爬上金属墙，发现两个狭长的洞口，觉得像家一样安全，于是爬了进去。
[P30] 两只小蚂蚁在洞中遭遇强大力量被弹射出去，落地后因精疲力尽，爬到阴暗角落沉沉睡去。
[P31] 两只小蚂蚁在黑暗中被同伴的脚步声唤醒，跟随队伍搬运水晶，爬上光滑的墙面，选好水晶后踏上归途。
[P32] 两只小蚂蚁站在蚁窝入口，听到地下传来的欢笑声，意识到自己终于回到家园，感到无比快乐和归属感。
